page.content:
Venetian traveler whose book advertised Yuan Cathay to Europe.

How Marco Polo connects

  • Concept: Pax Mongolica — Polo's journey is the famous European use of the Mongol-era roads.
  • Location: Quanzhou — Polo described the port of Zayton, identified with Quanzhou.

What is Marco Polo?

Marco Polo's late-thirteenth-century journey, whether every mile is exact, is the European popular memory of the Pax Mongolica roads from the Levant to Khanbaliq and the China coast.

Key threads lead to Pax Mongolica and Quanzhou.
